prompt.problem_text: The job-shop scheduling problem: n jobs and m machines; every job is a fixed sequence of m operations, one on each machine, each with an integer duration; a machine processes one operation at a time, without interruption; minimise the makespan (the completion time of the last operation). An instance file gives n and m, then one line per job with m pairs `machine duration` (machines numbered from 0) in the order in which the job visits them. A solution file has `n m makespan` on its first line, then m lines: line k lists the jobs (numbered from 1) in the order in which machine k-1 processes them.
prompt.solver_text: a tabu search for the job-shop problem (moves of operations on the critical path, estimated makespans, visited solutions recorded in hash tables, perturbation when the search stalls), open-source C++, one file `src/JSP.cpp`
prompt.time_text: 300 seconds of CPU time for every instance, whatever its size
prompt.io_text: `solver <instance file> <solution file> -t <seconds> -seed <int>`; it must write the solution file and print a `TRACE <seconds> <makespan>` line on standard output whenever its best makespan improves
prompt.class_text: job-shop instances in which every job visits every machine exactly once, integer durations, with {lo} to {hi} operations (jobs x machines)
prompt.size_text: `--n` is the number of operations (jobs x machines; the service asks for sizes from {lo} to {hi}).
